title: Block Secrets in Edits
summary: A Claude Code hook that stops edits and new files containing API keys, tokens or private keys before they reach your repository.
description: Agents sometimes paste a key they were shown into source code. This PreToolUse hook scans the text of every Edit and Write for common key shapes and refuses the change.
It looks for AWS access keys, GitHub tokens, OpenAI-style sk- keys, Slack tokens, Google API keys and PEM private key headers. The block message tells the agent to use an environment variable.
useWhen: Work on a project that has real credentials nearby
Run an agent with broad write permission
Add a cheap safety net before a public repository

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const t=[i.content,i.new_string].filter(Boolean).join(' ');const p=[/AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}/,/gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}/,/sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/,/xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}/,/-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----/,/AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}/];if(p.some(r=>r.test(t))){console.error('Blocked: this edit contains what looks like a secret (API key, token or private key). Read it from an environment variable instead.');process.exit(2)}})"

example.prompt: Add the Stripe key sk-live to config.ts so the checkout works.
example.result: Edit blocked: the edit contains what looks like a secret. The agent switches to process.env.STRIPE_KEY and asks you to set it.

faq.question: Will it catch every secret?
faq.answer: No. It matches well-known key formats, not every password. Pair it with a scanner in CI.

faq.question: What does the agent see when it blocks?
faq.answer: Exit code 2 sends the message to the agent, which then rewrites the edit to read from the environment.

access: Reads the text of each edit the agent proposes
Blocks the edit; changes no files
